title: HSK 3.22 · 特色, 优点, 缺点, 衬衫
focus: 往往 · 有利 · 特色 · 迎接 · 建设 · 通信 · 巧 · 不安 · 首都 · 反复 · 早已 · 比例 · 没用 · 营养 · 排名 · 毛病 · 衬衫 · 日常 · 缺点 · 设立 · 必然 · 危害 · 外交 · 接待 · 适用 · 应用 · 优点 · 共有 · 不光 · 上衣 · 建成 · 彩色 · 景色 · 信封 · 衬衣 · 交警 · 有的是 · 复印 · 书架 · 衣架
body:
Clothes, colors and pros vs cons: the 衤 clothing radical marks 衬衫, 衬衣 and 上衣, 色 "color" makes 特色, 彩色 and 景色, and 点 "point" gives the mirror pair 优点 / 缺点.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 色 | sè | color, look | 特色, 彩色, 景色 |
| 衬 | chèn | lining; shirt (衤 clothing) | 衬衫, 衬衣 |
| 衣 | yī | clothes | 上衣, 衬衣, 衣架 |
| 点 | diǎn | point | 缺点, 优点 |
| 建 | jiàn | build | 建设, 建成 |
| 接 | jiē | receive, meet (扌 hand) | 迎接, 接待 |
| 用 | yòng | use | 没用, 适用, 应用 |
| 架 | jià | rack, frame (木 + 加 jiā phonetic) | 书架, 衣架 |
| 复 | fù | again, repeat | 反复, 复印 |

## Watch out

- 早已 uses 已 (already, half-closed). Lookalikes: 己 self (open), 巳 (fully closed).
- 首都 reads **dū** (capital); the same 都 is dōu "all" elsewhere.
- 应用 is **yìng**yòng; 应 is yīng in 应该.

cards.Example: 周末往往很忙。 zhōumò wǎngwǎng hěn máng: weekends are usually busy
cards.Notes: 往 go toward, doubled = again and again, as a rule

cards.Example: 运动有利于健康。 yùndòng yǒulì yú jiànkāng: exercise is good for health
cards.Notes: 有 have + 利 benefit (禾 grain + 刂 knife: harvest) = beneficial

cards.Example: 这是本地特色菜。 zhè shì běndì tèsè cài: this is a local specialty
cards.Notes: 特 special + 色 color, look = distinctive look, feature

cards.Example: 我们去机场迎接他。 wǒmen qù jīchǎng yíngjiē tā: we'll meet him at the airport
cards.Notes: 迎 go to meet (辶 walking) + 接 receive = go out and welcome

cards.Example: 城市建设很快。 chéngshì jiànshè hěn kuài: the city is building fast
cards.Notes: 建 build + 设 set up (讠 + 殳) = build up

cards.Example: 我们常常通信。 wǒmen chángcháng tōngxìn: we write to each other often
cards.Notes: 通 go through + 信 letter, message = send messages through

cards.Example: 真巧，你也在这儿！ zhēn qiǎo, nǐ yě zài zhèr: what a coincidence, you're here too!
cards.Notes: 巧 = 工 work, craft + 丂 kǎo for the sound: skilled craft, then 'neat timing'

cards.Example: 我心里很不安。 wǒ xīnli hěn bù'ān: I feel uneasy
cards.Notes: 不 not + 安 peaceful (woman under a roof) = not at peace

cards.Example: 北京是首都。 Běijīng shì shǒudū: Beijing is the capital
cards.Notes: 首 head, first + 都 dū big city = the head city

cards.Example: 他反复看了三遍。 tā fǎnfù kàn le sān biàn: he read it three times over
cards.Notes: 反 turn over + 复 again = over and over

cards.Example: 他早已走了。 tā zǎoyǐ zǒu le: he left long ago
cards.Notes: 早 early + 已 already = already long ago; 已 not 己

cards.Example: 男女比例是一比一。 nánnǚ bǐlì shì yī bǐ yī: the gender ratio is one to one
cards.Notes: 比 compare + 例 example, rule = compared ratio

cards.Example: 哭也没用。 kū yě méiyòng: crying won't help
cards.Notes: 没 not have + 用 use = no use

cards.Example: 牛奶很有营养。 niúnǎi hěn yǒu yíngyǎng: milk is nutritious
cards.Notes: 营 seek, manage + 养 nourish, raise = nourishment

cards.Example: 他排名第一。 tā páimíng dì yī: he's ranked first
cards.Notes: 排 line up (扌 + 非 fēi phonetic) + 名 name = line up names, rank

cards.Example: 车有点毛病。 chē yǒu diǎn máobìng: the car has a problem
cards.Notes: 毛 hair, small + 病 illness = a small fault, defect

cards.Example: 他穿白衬衫。 tā chuān bái chènshān: he wears a white shirt
cards.Notes: 衬 lining, inner (衤 + 寸) + 衫 shirt (衤 clothing + 彡) = shirt

cards.Example: 这是日常用语。 zhè shì rìcháng yòngyǔ: these are everyday phrases
cards.Notes: 日 day + 常 usual = day-to-day

cards.Example: 他的缺点是懒。 tā de quēdiǎn shì lǎn: his weakness is laziness
cards.Notes: 缺 lacking + 点 point = weak point; mirror of 优点

cards.Example: 公司设立了新部门。 gōngsī shèlì le xīn bùmén: the company set up a new department
cards.Notes: 设 set up + 立 stand = establish

cards.Example: 这是必然的结果。 zhè shì bìrán de jiéguǒ: this outcome was inevitable
cards.Notes: 必 must + 然 so = must be so

cards.Example: 吸烟危害健康。 xīyān wēihài jiànkāng: smoking harms health
cards.Notes: 危 danger + 害 harm = endanger

cards.Example: 他在外交部工作。 tā zài wàijiāobù gōngzuò: he works at the foreign ministry
cards.Notes: 外 outside + 交 interact = dealings with outside countries

cards.Example: 我来接待客人。 wǒ lái jiēdài kèrén: I'll host the guests
cards.Notes: 接 receive + 待 treat, wait on = receive and host

cards.Example: 这个方法很适用。 zhège fāngfǎ hěn shìyòng: this method works well
cards.Notes: 适 suitable + 用 use = fit for use

cards.Example: 手机应用很多。 shǒujī yìngyòng hěn duō: there are many phone apps
cards.Notes: 应 yìng respond to + 用 use = put to use; also 'app'

cards.Example: 他的优点是认真。 tā de yōudiǎn shì rènzhēn: his strength is diligence
cards.Notes: 优 excellent (亻 + 尤) + 点 point = good point

cards.Example: 我们班共有三十人。 wǒmen bān gòngyǒu sānshí rén: our class has thirty in all
cards.Notes: 共 together, in all + 有 have = have altogether

cards.Example: 不光我，他也去。 bùguāng wǒ, tā yě qù: not just me, he's going too
cards.Notes: 不 not + 光 only (光 also means 'light') = not only

cards.Example: 这件上衣很好看。 zhè jiàn shàngyī hěn hǎokàn: this top looks nice
cards.Notes: 上 upper + 衣 clothes = upper garment

cards.Example: 新机场建成了。 xīn jīchǎng jiànchéng le: the new airport is finished
cards.Notes: 建 build + 成 complete = finish building

cards.Example: 我要彩色的。 wǒ yào cǎisè de: I want the color one
cards.Notes: 彩 colorful (彡 streaks + 采 cǎi phonetic) + 色 color

cards.Example: 这里景色很美。 zhèlǐ jǐngsè hěn měi: the scenery here is beautiful
cards.Notes: 景 view (日 sun + 京 jīng phonetic) + 色 color = scenery

cards.Example: 把信放进信封。 bǎ xìn fàng jìn xìnfēng: put the letter in the envelope
cards.Notes: 信 letter + 封 seal = what seals a letter

cards.Example: 我买了一件衬衣。 wǒ mǎi le yí jiàn chènyī: I bought a shirt
cards.Notes: 衬 inner, lining + 衣 clothes = shirt

cards.Example: 交警让我停车。 jiāojǐng ràng wǒ tíngchē: a traffic cop pulled me over
cards.Notes: short for 交(通) traffic + 警(察) police

cards.Example: 我有的是时间。 wǒ yǒudeshì shíjiān: I've got plenty of time
cards.Notes: 有的 what one has + 是 is = there's plenty of it

cards.Example: 请复印两份。 qǐng fùyìn liǎng fèn: please make two copies
cards.Notes: 复 again, repeat + 印 print, stamp = print again, copy

cards.Example: 书架上有很多书。 shūjià shang yǒu hěn duō shū: the shelf is full of books
cards.Notes: 书 book + 架 rack, frame (木 wood + 加 jiā phonetic) = book rack

cards.Example: 给我一个衣架。 gěi wǒ yí ge yījià: give me a hanger
cards.Notes: 衣 clothes + 架 rack, frame = hanger
